patterns_found.name: Double Top
patterns_found.evidence: Two distinct peaks visible near the 0.0000040-0.00000405 area with a trough between them around 0.00000392-0.00000395. Price is currently declining from the second peak toward the neckline support.

patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Prior bullish market structure showing higher highs and higher lows is being challenged by recent downside price action from the 0.00000405 resistance area.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price has rejected from the 0.0000040-0.00000405 area twice, forming a potential double top. Current price at 0.00000393 is testing the neckline support area. Volume has been relatively low during the recent decline.
limitations: Pattern confirmation requires candle close below key support levels.
Current candle may still be forming, so levels could shift.
